question: One paper through the whole pipeline, once per reading method of the figure-to-data step: what does each `amir-batch --figure-data ...` command take, cost and leave in its bundle, and how right is it on that paper's figures?
figures: testset.json: the 12 chart candidates the step picks. S02-S08 (six figures) have a full truth (truth/, 573 values in 13 charts); S10-S14 a sample of 60 values fixed by rule (truth-sample/); S09 none
not_new_to_every_method: S04 and S06 are in the five-figure smoke set the local engine was first built on (tests/data/figure_data/testset-5.json, 2026-11-09). No figure of this paper is in the 15-figure bench of rounds 1 to 3
command: amir-batch showcase/Public-test-manuscript.pdf -o samples/round-4-showcase/<label> --figure-data <method> [--figure-data-model <model>] (scripts/run_round4.sh), one run after the other
conversion: default options (Granite-Vision 4.1-4B for tables and figure descriptions, BiomedCLIP figure types), repeated in every run; the four bundles hold the same 15 pictures with the same boxes

engine.note: the commit of round 3 plus the uncommitted pipeline changes of this round (LOG.md section 2), frozen from the first run's start to the last run's end; the fix to the prepare phase found on the way (LOG.md section 7) went in after the last conversion had started and was applied to none of the four runs

ollama-gemma4-26b-qat.limits: 120 s per call, no new call once a figure took 600 s

cloud-sonnet-5-5.backend: openai-compatible: POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions, one request per figure, key from OPENROUTER_API_KEY in .env
cloud-sonnet-5-5.reply_schema: in the system prompt only (the host refuses it as response_format, as in round 3)

cloud-gemini-3-8-flash.backend: openai-compatible: POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions, one request per figure, key from OPENROUTER_API_KEY in .env
cloud-gemini-3-8-flash.reply_schema: enforced as response_format, every field required

agent-sonnet-5-5.backend: claude-cli: Claude Code 2.1.326 headless, one session per figure, effort high
agent-sonnet-5-5.limits: 600 s and 2 USD per figure; the longest session took 268 s and 0.87 USD
agent-sonnet-5-5.audit: runs/agent-sonnet-5-5/AUDIT.md: every session was offered those three tools and called no other

truth.made_by: three fresh claude-fable-5-2 sub-agents (truth/PROMPT.md), a fourth for the sample (truth-sample/PROMPT.md), while the runs were under way; none read a model's output
truth.cross_check: S04 and S06 against the truth of 2026-11-09 in tests/data/figure_data/truth (another agent, an older conversion): 144 of 144 and 40 of 40 paired values within 2 % of the axis

judges: one fresh claude-fable-5-2 sub-agent per run (judge/PROMPT.md), the six figures with a truth file

isolation.readers: the cloud model gets one HTTP request per figure and has no tool; an agent session has the three tools of one server bound to one figure folder (audited); the local engine reads one figure
isolation.truth: written into this folder while the runs were going; no reader has a file tool, so it was not locked
isolation.judges: told to read one run's folder, the truth and the figure images, and nothing of the other runs

after_fix: after-fix/: Figure 6 (S05) prepared again with the corrected capture and read once more by each method, outside the bundles (amir-figdata prepare --refs '#/pictures/5' --out ..., amir-figdata read)
scoring: scripts/compare_bundles.py: the scorer of rounds 1 to 3 as it is, a count by printed name with the charts put where the truth has them, and a count with names ignored (LOG.md section 6)

cost_usd.agent-sonnet-5-5: 2.97 as the Claude Code CLI reports it (what a session costs depends on the login it runs under)

not_published: the four bundles (samples/round-4-showcase/, git-ignored) and the comparison page built into that folder; this folder keeps the readings, the run records, the metrics, the truth and the judges' files, without the figure images
